full_judgment: 9. In view of the facts and circumstances and having regard to the materials on record it is found that the revisional application is hopelessly barred by limitation. The petitioner could not offer any satisfactory explanation for the delay and, as such, there is no reason to condone the same in filing the revisional application. Therefore, I find no merit in the Rule.
